patterns.note: Full-bleed, high-contrast imagery serves as the primary visual anchor for each major content section, often with large text overlaid.
Section titles use extremely large, bold, geometric sans-serif typography, creating a strong visual hierarchy and acting as a design element themselves.
A predominantly monochrome palette of black, white, and various greys is used, with product photography introducing muted tones and a single vibrant red accent for 'NEW IN' in the navigation.

Major content sections utilize a parallax scrolling effect where large background images remain fixed or move at a slower rate, while foreground text and product content scroll over them, creating a sense of depth and revealing new sections.

Each product category or thematic section is introduced by a full-bleed hero image with an oversized title, followed by product grids or supporting imagery, maintaining a consistent visual rhythm down the page.

technique_notes: The site employs a sticky header navigation that remains visible throughout scrolling.

Full-page scroll-triggered parallax effects are used to reveal content. Large, immersive background images are fixed in the viewport or scroll at a slower rate, while section titles and product displays scroll smoothly over them, creating a layered depth effect. This is consistent with the detected locomotive-scroll library.
Typography is used as a bold design element, with section headings rendered in a very large, heavy sans-serif font, often directly overlaid on striking imagery to command attention.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold, geometric sans-serif headings (~5-6x body text size) create a powerful visual presence, contrasted with smaller, regular-weight body and label text.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp; elements like buttons, images, and containers consistently feature crisp, unrounded corners.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy; hero sections are notably airy with generous negative space, while product grids maintain a balanced density.

standout: This site's design is distinctive for its dramatic, almost architectural use of full-bleed, high-contrast black and white photography and textured backgrounds, combined with massive, bold typography that acts as a primary visual element. The immersive parallax scrolling experience, where these striking backgrounds remain fixed as content scrolls over them, elevates the product display beyond a typical e-commerce site into a more editorial and artistic presentation.
